issues.title: Check that the page uses only its design tokens
issues.body:
The page should use no colour or font that is not in `tokens.css`. Add a test for it, run from `check.sh`.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Technical decisions
None: a test inside the existing page and checks.

prs.title: Test that the page uses only its design tokens
prs.body:
Adds a test that the page's style uses no literal colour and only the token fonts.

Closes #4
